product_overview: Conhecimento é um workspace pessoal em pt-BR para organizar Textos e conversar com uma IA que responde com base nesses textos. Nesta fase, o foco é criar, editar e excluir textos, além de usar o chat para obter respostas com fontes citadas.
core_goals: Visualizar a lista de textos do workspace e o sumário geral
Criar novos textos com título e conteúdo em markdown
Abrir um texto existente para revisar e editar seu conteúdo
Excluir textos da lista ou do editor
Iniciar conversas com a IA e enviar perguntas sobre os textos
Ver respostas da IA em streaming com fontes vinculadas aos textos de origem
Alternar entre conversas existentes e criar novas conversas

features.name: App shell and navigation
features.description: Permite navegar pelas áreas principais do produto e reconhecer a identidade visual e institucional do app.
user_flows: Open the app -> Land on /textos after automatic redirect -> See the product shell in pt-BR -> Use the header navigation to move between Textos and Chat -> Return to /textos by selecting the brand link -> Read the footer with company and contact information

features.name: List and create textos
features.description: Exibe os textos persistidos do workspace, mostra o sumário do workspace e permite criar um novo texto com título obrigatório e corpo em markdown.
user_flows: Navigate to /textos -> See the list of textos and the workspace sumário -> Fill in the title for a new texto -> Fill in the markdown content -> Submit the creation form -> See the new texto appear in the list with its generated sumário
Navigate to /textos -> See the empty-state message when no textos exist -> Create a first texto -> See the list update with the newly created item
Navigate to /textos -> Leave the title empty while entering content -> Submit the creation form -> See validation feedback and keep the texto from being created

features.name: Delete texto from list
features.description: Removes a texto directly from the list after a browser confirmation step.
user_flows: Navigate to /textos -> Choose a texto from the list -> Trigger deletion from the list item -> Confirm the browser dialog -> See the texto disappear from the list

features.name: Edit texto
features.description: Lets the user open a texto, change its title and markdown body, preview the rendered content, save changes, and access the generated sumário.
user_flows: Navigate to /textos -> Open a texto from the list -> See the editor for title and markdown content -> Change the title or body -> Save the texto -> See the saved confirmation and the updated content reflected in the editor
Navigate to /textos -> Open a texto from the list -> Switch to preview mode -> See the markdown rendered as formatted content -> Switch back to editing mode -> Continue editing in the textarea
Navigate to /textos -> Open a texto with an invalid id -> See the texto not found message -> Return to the texts list

features.name: Delete texto from editor
features.description: Allows the user to delete the currently open texto from inside the editor and return to the texts list.
user_flows: Navigate to /textos -> Open a texto in the editor -> Delete the texto from the editor -> Return to /textos -> See that the deleted texto no longer appears in the list

features.name: Chat with AI over textos
features.description: Supports creating or selecting a conversa, sending questions, streaming assistant replies, and viewing cited source textos in the conversation.
user_flows: Navigate to /chat -> See the list of conversas in the sidebar -> Create a new conversa -> Type a question -> Send the message -> See the user message appear and the assistant reply stream in gradually -> See fonte chips when the assistant cites source textos
Navigate to /chat -> Select an existing conversa -> Review the prior messages -> Type a follow-up question -> Send the message -> See the new assistant response appended to the same thread
Navigate to /chat -> Open a conversa with no messages -> See the empty-state copy -> Send the first question -> See the conversation populate with the user message and streamed assistant answer
Navigate to /chat -> Type a question using invalid or insufficient input -> Submit the message -> See the validation or error feedback and keep the conversation thread visible

routes.description: Lista de textos, formulário de criação, sumário do workspace e exclusão
Editor de um texto (título, corpo markdown, preview, sumário gerado, salvar e apagar)
Conversas com IA sobre os textos, stream de resposta e fontes citadas

features.name: App shell and navigation
features.description: Header with product name, person and company, nav links Textos and Chat, footer with company legal data. Locale is pt-BR. No login.
user_interactions: Open the app and land on /textos after redirect from /
Click Textos in the header nav
Click Chat in the header nav
Click the Conhecimento brand to return to /textos
Read footer with Arthur Bamberg, Bamberg Desenvolvimento de Software, Canoas/RS, CNPJ and phone

features.name: List and create textos
features.description: List persisted textos with generated sumário, show workspace sumário, create a new texto with required título and markdown corpo
user_interactions: See heading Textos and workspace sumário
Fill Título do novo texto
Fill Conteúdo (markdown)
Click Criar
See the new texto appear in the list with title and sumário
See empty-state copy when there are no textos
See error copy if create or list fails

features.name: Delete texto from list
features.description: Delete a texto from the list after a browser confirm dialog
user_interactions: Click the Apagar button on a list item
Confirm the native confirm dialog
See the texto disappear from the list

features.name: Edit texto
features.description: Open a texto, edit título and markdown corpo, toggle preview, save, and see IA sumário
user_interactions: Click a texto title in the list to open the editor
Change Título
Change Conteúdo in the textarea
Click Preview to render markdown
Click Editar to return to the textarea
Click Salvar and see Salvo confirmation
Click ← Textos to go back to the list
See Texto não encontrado when the id is invalid

features.name: Delete texto from editor
features.description: Delete the open texto from the editor and return to the list
user_interactions: Open a texto editor
Click Apagar
Land back on /textos without the deleted texto

features.name: Chat with AI over textos
features.description: Create or select a conversa, send a question, stream assistant tokens, show fontes linking to source textos, handle errors
user_interactions: Open Chat and see Conversas sidebar
Click Nova conversa
Select an existing conversa
Type a question in Mensagem
Press Enter or click Enviar
See pending user message and Aguardando a IA…
See streamed assistant markdown
See Fonte chips linking to /textos/:id when the model cites texts
See empty-state copy when the conversa has no messages
Copy an error report if the IA fails

known_limitations.issue: No authentication; a single seeded workspace is used for everyone on the local instance
known_limitations.impact: Tests must not expect a login screen

known_limitations.issue: Editor Apagar on /textos/[id] has no confirm dialog unlike the list
Local tests often run with AI_PROVIDER=fake so chat answers and sumários are stubs, not a real LLM
known_limitations.impact: Assert on UI structure (reply, fontes, sumário present) rather than specific Gemini prose

known_limitations.issue: Chat has no UI to attach specific textoIds; context is lexical search or all texts up to budget
known_limitations.impact: Do not look for an attach-text picker in MVP-A

known_limitations.issue: Web app is running in next dev (Turbopack), not production start
known_limitations.impact: Frontend TestSprite run is capped at 15 high-priority tests
